title: Mental Variables
note: Dimension table for the 'Mental Variables No.' column of Table V (referenced there as mental_ids, an array since a case can carry several). Per chapter-5-source.md, one of 15 general characteristics of mind. Consistent with 5.0.2's case No. 162 formula (MV.5 = 'indifference'), id 5 here is upekkha-sahagatam, 'associated with indifference'. Ids 6-8 are three of the four brahmavihāra (sublime states) -- mettā/karuṇā/muditā -- introduced pp. 102-103 pairing the first jhāna with loving-kindness, mercy, and sympathetic joy in turn; the fourth, upekkhā, reuses id 5 rather than getting a new id, now paired with the fourth jhāna.
